channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
item.description: Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore fine-tuned lightweight on-device Gemma models to flag impersonation scams in private chats in real time, with no data leaving the device; such fraud is over half of reported crimes there, costing S$4 billion since 2019. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is now generally available in GitHub Copilot for complex coding, agentic and reasoning tasks; early testing showed it solved more tasks than prior Gemini models on every coding benchmark, biggest gains in Copilot CLI. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Run fast, private agents on-device with LFM2.5-24B-A2B
item.description: Liquid AI's LFM2.5-24B-A2B packs 24B parameters but activates only 2B, delivering 131K context and tool calling for on-device private agents while decoding 184 tokens/s on M5 Max, 1.7x faster than the next-best model. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon is presented as the latest frontier model, opening access to developers, enterprises, scientists and consumers, with no parameter counts or capability details offered beyond that. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: GitHub’s model for secret detection: Finding more secrets with less noise
item.description: GitHub's context-aware secret classifier replaces its previous LLM pipeline, raising weighted acceptance by 11.5% and cutting median scan execution time by 86% while reducing false positives. (GitHub AI & ML)

item.title: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
item.description: Higgsfield's GPT-6 Astra extends AI video from about 1 minute to over 10 minutes while keeping creative agents consistent across long clips, alongside GPT-Image-2.5 for precise visuals and GPT-Live for voice filmmaking. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon scores 87% on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark, controls Boston Dynamics Spot zero-shot to step on a pedal and throw cans, and generates MuJoCo digital twins for Real2Sim robotics workflows. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Character.AI files for bankruptcy
item.description: Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the US with estimated liabilities of $50 million to $100 million, seeking to sell its assets as Disney leads bidding at $20 million.

item.title: GitHub App improvements for least privilege and management
item.description: GitHub shipped GitHub Apps improvements adding two fine-grained permissions, including repository_creation:write, so developers can move off classic PATs, create repositories with less privilege, and let repository admins attach repos to org-approved apps. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: GPT-5.6 helped break Chrome’s defenses for a $250,000 Google bounty.
item.description: Xbow's Brendan Dolan-Gavitt spent six days and about $40,000 in compute running OpenAI's gpt-5.6-sol against Chrome's source, chaining three independent bugs so ordinary JavaScript crossed two defense boundaries and escaped every sandbox, chasing Google's $250,000 bounty.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon is now GA. Argon ranks equal to GPT-6 Astra on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 60% of the Cost per Task with...
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon is now GA, tying GPT-6 Astra on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index while costing 60% of Astra per task, with a discount through Nov 30, as Google returns to public frontier models.

item.title: Character.ai's Bankruptcy Documents Show the Economics of AI Don't Work
item.description: Character.ai's bankruptcy filings show $13.8 million in monthly AI compute costs in 2024 against peak subscription revenue of just $2.8 million, with August 2026 losses still $8–9 million.

item.title: 实测Gemini 4 Argon：知识工作强劲但体验糟糕，卡兹克称难撼Claude Opus 5.5与GPT-6 Astra
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon became fully available on October 13. Pro members can use it in the Gemini app, while Antigravity requires the $100 Ultra membership. In the author's hands-on testing, it was strong at knowledge-heavy professional tasks, ranked first overall on Vals Index (68.9) at only $15.68 per run, but placed second-to-last on CUA-bench at just 4.83%. Its front-end results trail GPT-6 Astra, it burns through quota quickly, and its Chinese writing has a strong AI flavor. The overall experience is poor, and subscribing to Ultra is not recommended.

item.title: AI coworker for 14 million businesses goes live: WorkBuddy joins the contact list, group-chat checkmarks become tasks, and outputs are sent straight back to WeCom
item.description: For 14 million enterprises, Tencent WorkBuddy's October 14 integration with Enterprise WeChat puts its bot in the contact list, calls ten capabilities including messages, documents and meetings, and turns checked group-chat messages into tasks whose outputs return to Enterprise WeChat. (AIbase)

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon is now fully rolled out, but after hands-on testing the author doubts it can unseat Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra.
item.description: Google's Gemini 4 Argon opened to all on October 14, but an author who paid $100 for Ultra access found it unable to unseat Claude Opus 5.5 or GPT-6 Astra, tracing Google's model delays and August 5 leadership shake-up.

item.title: Developing Gemini 4 Argon responsibly and safely
item.description: Google's Gemini 4 Argon safety and security approach is the stated subject, yet the text repeats one identical pointer three times and gives no specifics, data or detail. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Visual Studio Copilot and SSMS Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-103572)
item.description: Johann Rehberger disclosed CVE-2026-103572, a remote code execution flaw in Visual Studio Copilot and SQL Server Management Studio where trailing dots in filenames bypass path validation and write .mcp.json or settings files, enabling arbitrary command execution via prompt injection.

item.title: GPT 5.6 Sol btw
item.description: XBOW used OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol to build a Windows Chrome full-chain exploit in six days on $40,000 of compute, earning Google's $250,000 bounty—yet the text is only that phrase, repeated three times.

item.title: Secret scanning blocks Anthropic keys by default, adds Salesforce
item.description: GitHub secret scanning now detects new secret types from Salesforce, Anthropic and Cloudsmith, with Anthropic keys blocked by push protection by default and Salesforce joining as a scanning partner. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
item.description: Character.AI, the interactive chatbot platform launched just five years ago, has filed for bankruptcy and will sell some of its assets to Disney for $20 million.
